# 2 Baruch Chapter 49 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 49:1 — question about resurrection form

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "In-what-form will-those-live who-live in-your-day?" |
| LOGOS | "In what form will those live who live in your day?" |
| PNEUMA | "In what form will the people live who are alive in your day?" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. PNEUMA's expansion 'the people live' adds words not in the Syriac; the original is a more compact interrogative.

---

## 49:2 — chains/fetters of evil

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "these-fetters which-are-now in-evil" |
| LOGOS | "these chains that are in evil" |
| PNEUMA | "the shackles of evil they now carry" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Chains' renders the Syriac term appropriately; PNEUMA's gloss 'they now carry' is an addition. EMET's 'fetters' is acceptable but 'chains' is more common in English.

---
